articles.summary: 1stdibs.com, Inc. (Nasdaq: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design products, announced today that CEO David Rosenblatt and CFO Tom Etergino will present at the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event Conference in Los Angeles on Wednesday, October 21 at 12:30 PM ET.
